text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Hawa!? A rare monster figure
is listed for sale!?

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Mmh, so cute!
I can't let this chance slip by...!!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
...Phew. I hit 'buy now.'
And now my wallet's taken massive damage...

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
I have to hold back on sweets for a while.
And buying snacks at the shopping district, too...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And so, Matikane Tannhauser unexpectedly succeeded in her diet.
